full_judgment: 45. It emerged from the mouth of PW 2 that Md. Ismail Ali (PW 13), Md Zakaria (PW 12) and Nabab Ali alias Nawab Ali (PW 8) had been present when he had gone to carry out Inquest and he inquired of the wounds upon the deceased and what he learnt had been stated in the Report. The alleged Dying Declaration was made by deceased Ali Reza round about 11.00 PM on 24-11-2001 and if deceased Ali Reza would have at all brought into being any Dying Declaration to PW 8, PW 12 and PW 13 they would have definitely stated the fact of disclosure to PW 2 that deceased Ali Reza in Dying Declaration depicted convict-appellant Shahin as the offender who caused his death and there was no earthly reason on the part of PW 8, PW 12 and PW 13 in concealing the fact of disclosure by deceased Ali Reza.
